parameters.content:
## master : first_setup

Installs Sorted Signals on a blank n8n. Assumes GitHub and Telegram credentials already work.

1. List config, prompts, and workflows folders from hellovamsi/sorted_signals on main.
2. Same-canvas sub-run per file. Switch: csv / prompt / workflow json.
3. Existing tables are not created or changed. Existing prompt files are not overwritten. Existing workflows are skipped.
4. After the loop, retarget Lookups and call-workflow nodes by name.

Does not copy user_config (that is master : setup). Does not probe Gmail, Supabase, Jina, GitHub, or Telegram. n8n API credential is required on create nodes.

## File loop
CSVs first, then prompts, then workflow JSON.
Execute Workflow v1.3 uses this workflow ID, mode each, wait, continue on error.

## One GitHub file
Get file, then Switch csv / prompt / json.
CSV: list tables; skip if the named table exists; else create and seed.
Prompt: Read/Write Files from Disk at prompt paths; skip if the file exists.
JSON: create missing workflows only.
